digest.component_or_area: LLM gate orchestration and cost optimization
propositions: Per-gate LLM costs measured at plan-review 3.02 dollars, code-review 1.42 dollars, completion-verifier 2.24 dollars, averaging 11.85 dollars per completed ticket.

Cheap-model experiments (Nova Pro, Haiku, Nova 2 Lite) identified ~30-40x cost reduction for plan-review finder slot and completion-verifier models but revealed Nova Pro disqualification (3 false-accept epochs), Haiku accuracy gaps (87% parity), and blocking-criteria recall at 50-57%.

Code-review severity axes are structurally inert due to routing-level disconnection (blocking_enabled=False on 98.2% of criteria) and unreachable 0.95 threshold rather than under-reporting or fleet cleanliness, rendering the ordinal ladder unexercised near decision boundaries.

Bedrock error spike (77 InvocationClientErrors on Nova family 2026-08-10/11) fully attributed to MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS validation (fixed by e800), but claude models (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) remained unaffected and alarms lack cheap-model visibility.

Five CloudWatch alarm firings from 2026-08-12 include three true-positive review-interrupt bounds (bound-exceeded margin 10-130s) and two false positives from observability.sh probe over-matching LLM prose, indicating DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX undersizing and marker-pattern contamination in metric emission.

Deprecation removal-readiness audit found zero scheduled removals met their conditions (v1.0.0 floor unmet), identified .gitattributes migration arm as the only genuinely dead code, and requires operator ruling on opening a third pre-1.0 breaking window for single-pass-review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL supersession.
